principles: Only verified GET / QUERY opcodes with exact line citations are whitelisted.
Zero write, set, release, touch, reset, or upgrade commands.
No heuristic opcode probing or blind parameter scanning.
GET tags are verified directly from GET wrapper functions, never inferred from SET names.
Every parameter layout and struct offset is anchored in binary disassembly, libgphoto2, or baseline capture code.

Tier_1.focus: 固件版本与设备唯一标识 (Firmware & Identity)

Tier_2.focus: 实时运行状态 (Real-time Core State - 0x9402)

Tier_3.focus: 存储介质与卡槽可用性 (Storage Capability)

Tier_4.focus: 机身能力枚举集合 (Capability Enums - 0x9108)

Tier_5.focus: 标准属性描述符 (Standard PTP Descriptors - 0x1014)

Tier_6.focus: 全量固件配置镜像 (Full Serialized DAT Dump - 0x9421)
